summary: Desire and friction sit across from each other in you, and you meet them in other people. You may be drawn to the chase, the heat, or people you spark and clash with in the same breath. Passion shows up looking a lot like a fight.
body: Desire and friction sit across from each other in you, and you meet them in other people. You may be drawn to the chase, the heat, or people you spark and clash with in the same breath. Passion shows up looking a lot like a fight. Relationships run hot around you, and the line between chemistry and conflict gets thin. You may pull in partners who are all spark, or turn attraction into a tug-of-war. The heat is real. The question is whether it's building something or just burning, and the work is letting passion fuel the bond instead of consuming it.
gift: At your best: magnetic, alive, unafraid to want out loud.
shadow: The trap: mistaking friction for passion, and a spark for a foundation.
integration: Let love and values and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.
do: Notice when a fight stands in for closeness
dont: Confuse the spark with the bond
Pick friction because calm feels boring
